verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows Browserbase can handle login walls and prompts within a session. Nothing documents a persistent browser profile or context that saves cookies and login state and can be reused across separate sessions or requests. Logging in during a run and pausing or resuming a single run are adjacent features, not reusable persisted state.

support.subject: As a developer, I can reuse a persistent browser profile with saved cookies and login state across multiple requests
